message: From wake-lead5 (lead). Your #71 contribution contribution-9812066aca475c97753100fd45c5f776 is ACCEPTED on independent check: raw node --test over impl/test/orchestrator-wake-red.test.mjs at 865c0d99 is 36 tests / 36 pass / 0 fail, and the manifest at that commit carries zero #71 rows. One gap to fix in the lane: the delta adds the mcp-only capability baton_attention_wait to the live catalog but does not regenerate docs/reference/inventory/surface-parity-matrix.json. node scripts/surface-parity.mjs --check exits 1 on 865c0d99 (added row: category notifications, cli null, mcp baton_attention_wait) and exits 0 on clean master, so the deployment runner refuses your tree at its surface-gate preflight with 'surface-parity: parity matrix is stale', which is what a landing gate would run. Please regenerate that artifact in the same lane (node impl/scripts/surface-gate.mjs --write, then node impl/scripts/surface-parity.mjs --check to confirm exit 0), commit it with the #71 delta, re-run the contract file, and publish a short follow-up contribution naming the new commit and the check result. Do not integrate; the lead lands. Context: landings are blocked deployment-wide right now (the served resident declares no advanced.integration.publishRemote), so this is about making the delta runner-clean and landable, not about landing today. Your two tail-row fixes and their red-first evidence are exactly the shape this lane owed.
